The majority of the least developed countries (33/46) are in Sub-Saharan
Africa [1], while about one-fifth are in Asia [1]. There are also small islands in the
Pacific [1].
[Max 3 marks]

They are very small so they have a limited market to sell goods [1]; they may have very
limited natural resources [1]; they are far from the main international markets [1];
transport costs to the main markets are high [1].
[Max 3 marks]

Countries with a high life expectancy are HICs [1] and all are located in either Asia or
Europe [1]. In contrast, countries with a low life expectancy are mainly LICs [1] and all are
in Africa [1].
[Max 4 marks]

Any two from: GDP (gross domestic product) [1]; GNP (gross national product) [1]; GNI
(gross national income) [1].
[Max 2 marks]

People with higher levels of literacy are able to secure better jobs, which provide a better
income [1] and allow a higher standard of living [1]. There is a very strong relationship
between levels of female literacy and infant mortality rates [1]. People who are literate
are much more able to access medical and other information that will help them achieve
a higher quality of life than are those who are illiterate [1]. Female literacy is the key to
lower fertility [1]. Female education increases knowledge of birth control and creates
greater social awareness and opportunities for employment [1].                   [Max 3 marks]

There are many ways that uneven development may be reduced. These include trade,
international aid, debt relief and government projects to reduce regional inequalities within a
country. Debt relief may reduce financial pressures on a country but may lead to dependency
and conditions of repayment/high interest rates. Trade is potentially long term and may help
a country develop from import substitution to export orientation. Answers should outline
advantages and disadvantages of two or more ways to reduce uneven development. Answers
should also refer to named examples. These may be between countries and/or within
countries. If the answer to this question does not include an evaluation, do not award more
than 5 marks.
[Max 7 marks]
